body:
388 Phillip St (OPA 72 & Z-25-26)
Changes to the Official Plan and the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
388 Phillip Inc and The Planning Partnership are proposing to amend the City’s Official Plan and Zoning By-law to permit a food store as an ancillary use, and to permit all ancillary uses to occupy up to 8,000 square metres of building floor area.
Official plan changes requested include:
To permit a food store as a complementary use
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
To permit a food store as a complementary use
To permit ancillary uses to occupy a floor area of 3175 Sq.m or 26% of the building floor area.
To permit a proposed new geothermal connection from 388
Phillip St, to the existing vertical geothermal system at the Hub, at 130
Columbia St W. This proposal is an extension of the existing
closed loop vertical system on the neighbouring property, and does not include
a new vertical well on the subject lands.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height and Non-residential floor space
Building Height: 1 Storey (Existing)
Food Store: 5500 square metres
Ancillary Uses: 3,175 square metres
Employment Uses: 3,185 square metres
Parking
Parking: 200 Vehicular Parking Spaces (Existing)
Loading: 3 Loading areas, 6 indoor and outdoor spaces (Existing)
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
Give feedback
Ask a question, read answers
Questions and answers will be published on this site for public viewing. If your username includes your first or last name, or your email address, these will be available for public viewing. Do not include personal or identifying information in your question; if your question is of a personal nature, consider contacting a member of the project team directly. For more information, please refer to our privacy policy.
Questions will be answered by a member of the Planning department within two business days. Some questions may require more time but they will be answered as soon as the information for the response can be collected.
